findings.problem: In-place additive builds retain rows and edges absent from replacement snapshots.
findings.decision: Fresh validated database plus atomic replacement; per-container and full-release locator/payload pruning.
findings.proof: Fixture v1 to v2 removes Works 1002/1005, Legacy Field, contributor edges, payload assets, members, and containers.

findings.problem: LCC comment, parser, and priority semantics disagree for letter-plus-digit codes.
findings.decision: Store main section, full alphabetic subclass, and numeric stem; use section for broad rules.

findings.problem: Queue emits duplicate Work rows across reasons/tiers.
findings.decision: Select minimum tier rank per Work and aggregate stable winning/all reason lists.
findings.proof: Builder invariant and test require COUNT(*) = COUNT(DISTINCT gid).

findings.problem: Documented compressed-member payload had no tracked pack/hash/range verifier chain.
findings.decision: Deterministic gzip-in-uncompressed-USTAR pack, locator rescan, exact range/member/content verification.
findings.proof: Fixture verifies one container and three exact members; stale assets are removed.

findings.problem: Normalized names become person keys and direct canonical matches, risking false merges and Unicode loss.
findings.decision: Store source attribution occurrences and export validated pg-observation-0.1 only; --apply fails closed.
findings.proof: Tests preserve Unicode/roles/aliases/pseudonyms and reject canonical fields/attribute identifiers.

findings.problem: Deterministic wording lacks a measured portable SQLite equivalence definition.
findings.decision: Logical SHA-256 is authoritative; binary SHA-256 is a non-authoritative receipt.
findings.proof: Two clean builds in distinct directories have equal logical and deterministic payload receipts.

findings.problem: Direct transfer filters to author and drops other contribution roles.
findings.decision: Export every source-listed role and order on Work and attribution-claim records.
findings.proof: Fixture preserves author, translator, editor, and compiler; v2 role replacement is exact.
